study: 电商异常履约订单处置优先级与历史回测
outcome: first review strictly after decision and at or before decision+30d, score 1-2
daily_budget: floor(fraction * that day's new eligible cohort); no carryover; equal service cost assumed
primary_selection_metric: validation 20% daily-quota event recall, highest candidate; ties prefer simpler rule
primary_recommendation_gate: frozen validation winner improves test event recall over oldest_purchase by at least 0.02, paired week-bootstrap lower bound >0, both test subperiod differences >0
bootstrap_unit: calendar week; paired comparison with fixed trained rules
forbidden_priority_inputs: future handoff timestamp or its presence
scope: event-time historical simulation of newly eligible orders, not a live backlog or an intervention effect; previous projects have already inspected 2018 aggregate data
